findings.title: Unit-Test-Coverage < 80 %
findings.expected: Unit test coverage > 80% for all cdc source files
findings.observed: RESOLVED — tests/test_cdc_changefeed_buffer.cpp (23 tests for ChangefeedBuffer: lifecycle, flush, flushFor, stats, setConfig, compression, rate limiting, DLQ, async flush) and tests/test_cdc_changefeed_core.cpp (43 tests for Changefeed push subscription API: SubscriptionFilter::matches(), subscribe/unsubscribe, SubscriptionHandle RAII/move, callback filtering, getStats, getLatestSequence, clear, listEvents variants, getEvent, getWatermarks, JSON roundtrip for all event types) added; closes Issue #1623
findings.evidence: PR adds 66 new unit tests across two new test files covering previously untested code paths

findings.title: At-least-once delivery not guaranteed for SSE connections
findings.claim_text: [x] At-least-once delivery guarantees with consumer acknowledgement (Issue: #1606)
findings.expected: At-least-once guarantee for all CDC delivery mechanisms including plain SSE
findings.observed: At-least-once implemented only for Consumer Groups (ConsumerGroupManager::fetchEventsAtLeastOnce() in consumer_group.cpp); SSE connections (GET /changefeed/stream) have no acknowledgement loop; connection drop causes event loss
findings.evidence: ROADMAP Known Issues: 'At-least-once delivery is not yet guaranteed for SSE connections'; no SSE-ACK logic found in changefeed.cpp
findings.issue_title_suggestion: feat(cdc): extend at-least-once delivery guarantee to SSE connections

findings.title: Change log retention not runtime-configurable
findings.claim_text: [x] Change log TTL and size-based retention policies (Issue: #1608)
findings.expected: Automatic time-based and size-based retention configurable at runtime without server restart
findings.observed: Manual admin trim via CDCAdmin::purgeOlderThan() (REST: POST /changefeed/retention) is implemented; no automatic background retention thread or runtime config hook found
findings.evidence: ROADMAP Known Issues: 'Change log retention policies are not configurable at runtime'; cdc_admin.cpp provides purgeOlderThan() only as manual trigger
findings.issue_title_suggestion: feat(cdc): runtime-configurable change log retention policies (TTL + size-based)
